audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 3 gave levels 2-5 to Kayle or Skill while whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] and the early paragraph all say Aurora out-ranges and out-trades melee Kayle. Packet chart lists Aurora there.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is 900 range on a 9s cooldown against a 175-range melee with one rank of Celestial Blessing; Across the Veil resets her spacing every 22s.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 set to Aurora in both layers, ratings dropped to 4/10.

audit.why: spikes[] key level 6 to Divine Ascent plus Divine Judgment, first item to Nashor's, and 2+ items to the full-ranged kit — all real names and all the right breakpoints.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] claimed a root off a 'passive mark detonation'. Riot's text gives Twofold Hex a curse plus a recast that drags curses back, and Spirit Abjuration only spawns healing spirits — there is no mark root. Cooldown block carried no numbers and named no abilities.
audit.why: The real punish window is the recast: the curse damages again on the way back, so the gap between cast and recast is when to step. Between Worlds (140s at rank 1) is the only hard CC in her kit, and Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell.
audit.corrected: whys[2] rewritten to the curse-recast pattern, cooldowns and dos/donts now carry 9s / 22s / 140s and call for anti-heal.

edits.before: With Q, W and her passive mark online she roots-and-bursts you and exiles out, and your melee range plus no escape can't punish the trade.
edits.after: With Twofold Hex, Across the Veil and her spirits online she curses, recasts to drag it back through you, and blinks out before you answer.

edits.before: Her escape. Scale past it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Twofold Hex is 9s at rank 1 — step up on the recast, not before.

edits.before: Aurora wastes Twofold Hex (Blink) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell — Oblivion Orb early.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1 — hold R for that leap alone.

edits.before: - Aurora Twofold Hex: matchup-defining — Her escape. Scale past it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twofold Hex: 9s at rank 1 — it curses on the way out and again on the recast, so break the line. - Across the Veil: 22s leap into invisibility, not untargetability. - Divine Judgment: 160s.

edits.before: Track Aurora's Twofold Hex (Blink): Her escape. Scale past it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Track Twofold Hex, 9s at rank 1: the recast drags the curse back through you. Then poke and scale.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Divine Judgment's' — false positive.
